title: How to be so disciplined it feels *illegal*

text: Motivation is a scam. It shows up *after* you start.

label: RULE 1
head: Decide the night before
sub: Write tomorrow's 3 tasks on paper. Nothing left to decide at 7am.

items.head: Gym clothes by the bed
items.sub: Dressed before your brain can argue.

items.head: Phone in another room
items.sub: First hour of work with zero notifications.

label: RULE 3
head: Make it stupidly small
sub: 1 pushup. 1 page. Nobody quits something that easy.

label: RULE 4
head: Stop fighting temptation
sub: Delete the app. Keep junk food out of the house.
